_comment_policy: config.policy.advisories.block is OFF here, and it must not be in a real project.
This demo ships no composer.lock (a generated one would be most of the
repository by volume), so `composer install` falls back to `update` and
resolves fresh. Composer refuses to install anything carrying an open
security advisory, and at any moment some transitive dependency of a
framework has one — so the demo would break weekly for reasons that say
A real project commits a lockfile, installs from it, and leaves this alone.
name: dx/demo-laravel
